description: Three quantisers sharing one scale setting, each with a pitch in and out and a gate that fires when the note changes

params.text: Picks which channels are quantised: only the first, none of them, or all three
Picks what the pitches are snapped to: the whole Scale, a Triad, or Root+5th
Picks the chord the triad is built from: Major, Augmented, Minor or Diminished

inputs.text: The pitch to be quantised on that channel
A gate here holds that channel's quantiser, so the pitch stops following the input

outputs.text: A gate from that channel each time its quantised pitch changes
